ModMetaData.name: Covetheus (No HAR)
ModMetaData.author: Lelbaro, Zaljerem, RhombusMaximus
ModMetaData.description:
Original mod by Lelbaro https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2077371272 1.4/1.5 update by Zaljerem HAR dependency removal by RhombusMaximus
Includes artificial person race, starting scenario, equipment as listed below.
Currently included: -USCSS Colony mission Scenario! -USCSS Hoodies! (different designs for Female and Male colonist). -Jumpsuits! (for Casual/Engineer wear). -Trapper Hats! -Backpack! (with camera and solar panel attachment).
No HAR dependency — uses vanilla ThingDef with Harmony patches for race features.
